column1: # Modern-name candidates that have been READ, and what the reader concluded.
# A candidate absent from this file fails `--check`. Do not add a row you have not read: every row
# here is a claim that a human looked at that sentence and decided. Verdicts in use:
#   ok          Read, and the link is right. Most rows: a saint's church or a pope's own name.
#   book-title  Read, and the link is on a BOOK rather than a man. Not fixed here, because it is
#               one instance of a class of 119 across 42 shapes ("1 Samuel", "1-2 Peter", "the
#               book of Ruth", "the longer ending of Mark") that the app has only ever ruled on
#               for "John", and settling the rest touches authorship. Recorded, not decided.
